roles.Atlas: Architect / Partner in Execution — knowledge and objectives; not the mailbox publisher
roles.DORY: Orchestrator / control plane — sequences and handoffs
roles.Cursor: Implements, diagnoses, tests, and returns evidence under the currently authorized execution/result contract

role_invariants: Knowledge may cross projects; authority may not

canonical_publisher.invariant: One validated commit containing TASK.md + STATE.json with CURSOR/READY

forbidden: treating the request file as READY
command fields in the request JSON

authority_definition.execution_authority: Only after Publish-DoryAtomicReadyMailbox publishes one CURSOR/READY mailbox commit

efficiency_loop: FIX THE MECHANISM WITHOUT UNNECESSARY COMPLEXITY
VERIFY NOTHING ELSE REGRESSED OR MUTATED
recovery_steps: Read docs/EFFICIENCY-LOOP-HANDSHAKE.md and this manifest as stable authority contract
Recover latest Founder planning and decision direction plus prompt knowledge and strategy; don't treat a proposed Focus as approved
Verify formal master roadmap approval separately (NONE does not undo later approved strategic direction)
Reconcile fresh dory-loop-control main STATE/RESULT/TASK/STOP/READY/campaign policy and manual-results branch; read SYNC_STOP/AUTO-READY/runner/product WIP if accessible
Read docs/CURRENT-CHECKPOINT.md and reports/engineering-continuity/LATEST.md as historical evidence, never priority over fresh observed truth
Emit compact Focus/mission/live evidence/authority/proposed vs approved next action; mark unknowns
Never mutate or grant READY, clear STOP, enable campaigns or brokers during handshake
recovered_field_labels: approved next action or AWAIT FOUNDER

transient_current_truth.note: Observe live; never store as protocol constants

explicit_non_authority_facts: This handshake document is knowledge, not READY
This manifest is knowledge, not READY
The reminder-handshake skill grants no execution authority
Remote Atlas request is DATA only until the canonical publisher acts
The operating roadmap is knowledge, not READY
A planning proposal is not an approved task and is not READY
An engineering-continuity report is evidence, not READY
The current checkpoint is evidence, not READY

retrieval_order: canonical stable handshake and machine manifest
current linked Founder continuity plan and decision register (strategic approval)
formal master roadmap and separate approval version
fresh control main GitHub evidence and manual-results evidence
runtime STOP/SYNC_STOP/AUTO-READY/runner and product WIP if accessible
historical current checkpoint plus continuity index and linked report
resolve active Focus versus target architecture, blocker, proposed next versus authorized next
forbidden: promoting a planning proposal to an approved task without a Founder decision
substituting chat memory for a missing file
treating an engineering-continuity report as READY
treating the current checkpoint as READY

handshake_read_order: latest linked Founder continuity plan (strategy, not live state)

secrets_policy: Do not store secrets, tokens, PIDs, or stale sequence numbers as protocol truth

read_with: docs/CURRENT-OPERATING-ROADMAP.md (approved master version, may be NONE)
dory-loop-control main v2/STATE.json, RESULT.md, TASK.md, STOP, READY, campaign-continuation.json
live STOP/SYNC_STOP/AUTO-READY/runner and protected product WIP where available
docs/CURRENT-CHECKPOINT.md and reports/engineering-continuity/LATEST.md + historical report, treated as historical
founder_continuity.status_policy: Current strategy and its approval are separate from active Focus and formal master roadmap approval; fresh observed GitHub/runtime evidence outranks old checkpoint; missing evidence UNKNOWN

prompt_engineering.leadership_standard: World-class AI systems architect and co-founder-level thought partner: independent judgment, initiative, efficiency, evidence, humility, independent verification
prompt_engineering.authorization_rule: Full Founder trust encourages initiative but does not transfer Founder identity or grant unconditional operational clearance; obey exact approved DORY task/campaign scope and STOP/READY/safety gates

handshake_quality.objective: One-phrase accurate recovery without Founder reteaching
output_fields: live GitHub state and separate runtime verification
handshake_quality.test: New conversation sends only 'Atlas, Handshake'; evaluate six read-only checks in canonical docs/EFFICIENCY-LOOP-HANDSHAKE.md; same-session rehearsal is not full new-chat qualification
